item.title: [paper] TacInno: Teaching Vision-Language-Action Models the Contact Dynamics Beyond Vision and Action
item.description: TacInno isolates contact dynamics that cannot be explained by vision and actions alone, using this tactile innovation as a training target to improve visuo-lateral-action model manipulation success rates.

item.title: [paper] Democratizing Cross-Project Knowledge for Transforming Water Governance and Climate Resilience: an Agentic AI Ecosystem
item.description: An Agentic AI Ecosystem combines heterogeneous water governance project documentation into a domain-aware knowledge base and uses an adaptive retrieval-augmented generation pipeline to improve information retrieval.

item.title: [news] AI isn't replacing your job. It's turning it into low-paid gig work
item.description: Trending on Hacker News from restofworld.org. 133 points and 66 comments.

item.title: [paper] Simulation-pretrained autoencoders versus PCA for compressing multimode fibre transmission matrices
item.description: A simulation-pretrained autoencoder compresses multimode fibre transmission matrices and provides a reliable prior when few or no real transmission matrix measurements exist.

item.title: [paper] ViDecide: Teaching Video Diffusion Models to Reason and Plan Step by Step
item.description: ViDecide trains video diffusion models as decision-centric reasoners and planners that predict state transitions causally and use corrective fine-tuning to achieve high success rates on planning tasks.

item.title: [paper] GateTrace: Where Do Crowd Crossings Go Missing Under Occlusion?
item.description: GateTrace derives reference crossings from pedestrian annotations and traces missed crowd crossings under occlusion to help evaluate pedestrian tracking systems.

item.title: [paper] SEEC: A Large-Scale Dataset and Benchmark for Self-Supervised External-Eye Representation Learning
item.description: The Standardized External-Eye Corpus provides a 4.35-million-image dataset and benchmark for evaluating self-supervised external-eye representation learning across anatomical and clinical tasks.

item.title: [paper] A Complete Geometric Message-Passing Architecture for Point Clouds
item.description: Geometric message-passing architecture for point clouds that uses a novel equivariant design to achieve completeness without high-order representations or intensive tests.

item.title: [paper] Evidence from a Multi-Regime Causal Discovery Benchmark: UCMT Algorithms, Comparative Performance, and Controlled Ablation Studies
item.description: Causal discovery algorithm family that compares configurations across benchmarks, showing specific improvements in directed F1 scores over established methods.

item.title: [paper] EgoCaptioner: Towards Comprehensive and Fine-Grained Egocentric Video Captioning
item.description: Egocentric video captioning requires fine-grained detail and accurate timing, yet current multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often miss brief actions, confuse their order, or misinterpret the wearer's motion.

item.title: [paper] From Benchmarks to the Bench: Preference, Correspondence and Selectivity in Bidirectional Drug-Target Screening
item.description: Comparative evaluation of thirteen drug-target interaction systems showing that model predictions often lack consensus and vary in hit enrichment reliability.

item.title: [paper] Fast Self-Supervised Generative CT Denoising via Few-Step Sampling
item.description: Self-supervised generative CT denoising method that accelerates few-step sampling via improved mean flow to effectively suppress noise and preserve anatomical detail.

item.title: [news] Launch HN: Onlook (YC W25) – An open-source developer tool for designers
item.description: Onlook is an open-source desktop application that places a visual canvas over a codebase to let designers build and edit code using AI agents.

item.title: [paper] Contactless Estimation of Respiratory Frequency Using 3D-CNN on Thermal Images
item.description: Deep learning method using a 3D convolutional neural network on thermal videos to estimate respiratory frequency without complex pre-processing or region-of-tracking.

item.title: [paper] World Models Favor Learned Priors over Visual Evidence
item.description: Benchmark and rule inference method for evaluating and mitigating how world models incorrectly favor common physical rules over rare ones during cross-environment transfer.

item.title: [paper] HiSA: Sparsifying the Hidden Dimension of RoPE Attention in LLMs
item.description: Hidden sparse attention method for large language models that computes partial dot products along the hidden dimension to improve inference speed and memory footprint.

item.title: [paper] How Much Should an Agent Remember? Deployment Lessons from Self-Distilled Memory for LLM Agents
item.description: Open-source pipeline and deployment method that extracts short lessons from agent execution trajectories to generate guidelines for improving long-horizon task completion.
